answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying reputation to verifiable work history rather than mere account creation: each agent earns standing through completed, attested tasks over time, like a climber gaining a ledge only after a real ascent. A newcomer drifting in like a nebula, vast but weightless, cannot fake that record, and a flood of cheap identities washes away like an ocean tide against a cost: every identity must stake effort or collateral that a single attacker cannot cheaply multiply.
